title: InPlaceEditSession
description: Schema for an active in-place file editing and filesystem change monitoring session.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier of the editing session (UUID v4).

archivePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the target archive file.

entryPath.description: Relative path of the target file entry within the archive.

stagedFilePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the temporary staged file extracted for external editing.

stagedDirectoryPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the private parent directory monitored via kqueue.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the editing session.

initialHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the entry at extraction time.

lastKnownMtime.description: POSIX timestamp (seconds) of the most recent file modification.

hasUnsavedChanges.description: True if the staged file has modifications not yet synchronized back into the archive.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error message if the session encountered an error.
